tenderSchedule.title: Tender for providing Man power services of 3Nos. of Drivers required at SLDC,KPTCL
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for providing Man power services of 3Nos. of Drivers required at O/o CEE, SLDC, KPTCL Bengaluru for a period of 12 Months
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Office SLDC AR Circle Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per terms and conditions of tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided Man power services in State / Central Government Departments / Organizations, Public sector / Private Companies / Banks and Financial Institutions, KPTCL / ESCOMs of contract value not less than Rs.14.52 Lakhs per annum evidencing the same, satisfactorily (usually not less than 100% of the tender amount ), to at least one reputed Organization for a minimum period of One year during the last three financial years (i.e. from FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26). The experience certificates issued by competent officers (not less than the cadre of EE OR equivalent cadre) are to be uploaded
The tenderer should be a registered company under Indian Companies Act 1956 (Optional)

The tenderer shall be a reputed manpower providing agency having valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labour / Directorate of Industries and Commerce, GOK for providing Manpower Services. Documentary proof in the form of certificate of registration issued by GoK is to be uploaded

The tenderer shall comply with all the provisions under Karnataka Minimum Wages Act, Labour Laws such as EPF, ESI, Payment of Wages, Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 etc.. and provide the necessary proof of its compliance every month together with the bill. In case the tenderer fails to provide such proof of payments made to the personnel in which month it is due and such default occurs for more than 3 months in any continuous period of 12 months, the same will be considered as Breach of Contract. The tenderer shall comply with all the statutory requirements evidencing the same. The self-declaration letter by the tenderer in the letterhead of the firm is to be uploaded along with the ESI and EPF registration certificate

The tenderer should be in a position to provide tendered No. of Manpower Services of Drivers within one week from the date of award of Contract. The self-declaration letter by the tenderer in the letterhead of the firm is to be uploaded

The tenderer whose contracts have been terminated/foreclosed/blacklisted/penalized by any Organizations during the last three(3) years (i.e. from FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26 ) due to non-fulfillment of contractual obligations /deficiency in service are not eligible to participate in the tender. The tenderer should clearly specify and upload self-declaration letter in writing in the letterhead of the firm, stating that they do not fall under this category

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL (i.e. from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26). A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV may result in rejection of bid. Bidders should furnish the self-declaration stating the above and upload the same along with the other documents in the relevant field in the KPP portal, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected

The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years in the last five years (i.e. from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26) an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 29.04 Lakhs (two times the Amount put to tender). Documentary proof certified by a Chartered Accountant and P&L sheets are to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
Others -- P& L sheets certified by the Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be registered under GST Act, proof of which should be submitted along with the tender document and should submit proof of the Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate certified by CA with UDIN No
Self Declaration letters pertaining to QRs

itemList.itemName: Providing Drivers to SLDC-The Service charges as percentage of value of Annual Contract Value provided that the service charges shall be between 5 percent to 10 percent only ,else such a bid will be rejected. In the slot specified in KPP portal for Amount (INR in figures), the bidder shall mention any number between 5 to 10 in the said slot. The number mentioned in the slot by the bidder will be treated as PERCENTAGE SERVICE CHARGES quoted by the bidder
itemList.specifications: As per tender terms and conditions:Tenderer shall quote Service charges as percentage of value of Annual Contract Price as per tender document
